title: 序批式反應槽操作~Sequencing batch reactor operation
focus: 將時間分區轉成可驗證的批次狀態機~Verifiable batch states from time-separated treatment
summary: SBR在同一槽以時間切換進水、反應、沉澱與排水。學徒建立兩槽排程及事件紀錄，檢查每次切換前條件，而非只按固定計時器。~An SBR sequences filling, reaction, settling and decant in one basin. Build a two-basin schedule and event log, checking transition conditions rather than relying only on a timer.

units.title: 每批污染質量輸入：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Per-batch pollutant input: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「每批污染質量輸入」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at per-batch pollutant input.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「每批污染質量輸入」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for per-batch pollutant input; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「每批污染質量輸入」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the per-batch pollutant input measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 兩批之間進水緩衝：調蓄與連續方程~Interbatch influent buffer: Storage and continuity
units.mechanism: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「兩批之間進水緩衝」觀察此因果關係。~Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at interbatch influent buffer.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：一小時內 Qin=2.0 m³/s、Qout=0.6 m³/s。公式 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt；代入 (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³。適用邊界：矩形單一歷線且無滲漏；真實設計必須積分完整降雨歷線。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: over one hour Qin=2.0 m³/s and Qout=0.6 m³/s. Formula ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt; substitution (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³. Boundary: One rectangular hydrograph without leakage; real design must integrate the full event hydrograph.
units.verify: 以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「兩批之間進水緩衝」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for interbatch influent buffer; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 最大容積等於每場雨都可用的容積。~Maximum volume equals the available volume for every storm.
units.practice: 先點選「兩批之間進水緩衝」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4320 m³。與基準 5040 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the interbatch influent buffer measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4320 m³. Compare with baseline 5040 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 雙槽週期與日能力：SBR週期與處理量~Two-basin cycles/daily capacity: SBR cycle and throughput
units.mechanism: 序批式反應槽用時間切換充填、反應、沉澱與排水；週期變長會降低每天可完成批次。本單元在「雙槽週期與日能力」觀察此因果關係。~An SBR separates fill, reaction, settling and decant in time; a longer cycle reduces daily batch capacity. Examine this relationship at two-basin cycles/daily capacity.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：每批排水V=200 m³、週期6 h、槽數2。公式 Qday=V(24/tcycle)N；代入 200*(24/6)*2 = 1600 m³/d。適用邊界：穩定批次理想排程，未含備援停機及進水暫存。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: decant volumeV=200 m³ per batch,6 h cycle and2 tanks. Formula Qday=V(24/tcycle)N; substitution 200*(24/6)*2 = 1600 m³/d. Boundary: Ideal steady batch schedule; redundancy downtime and influent equalization excluded.
units.verify: 在時間軸排列兩槽狀態，查進水高峰時是否仍有接收容積。在離線場景為「雙槽週期與日能力」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Schedule both tanks on a timeline and check receiving capacity during influent peaks. Build an offline evidence table for two-basin cycles/daily capacity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只縮短沉澱以增加批次可能使污泥隨排水流失。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Shortening settling solely to add batches may wash out solids during decant. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 批次數增加一定不影響出水品質。~More batches never affect effluent quality.
units.practice: 先點選「雙槽週期與日能力」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把週期改成8 h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1200 m³/d。與基準 1600 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the two-basin cycles/daily capacity measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only cycle time to8 h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1200 m³/d. Compare with baseline 1600 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 反應期有效水量：水力停留時間~Reaction-period effective volume: Hydraulic retention time
units.mechanism: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「反應期有效水量」觀察此因果關係。~Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at reaction-period effective volume.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
units.verify: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「反應期有效水量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for reaction-period effective volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: V/Q 就是每一滴水的精確停留時間。~V/Q is the exact residence time of every drop.
units.practice: 先點選「反應期有效水量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the reaction-period effective volume measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 曝氣階段供氧：氧轉移與曝氣功率~Aerated-phase oxygen: Oxygen transfer and aeration power
units.mechanism: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「曝氣階段供氧」觀察此因果關係。~Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at aerated-phase oxygen.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
units.verify: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「曝氣階段供氧」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for aerated-phase oxygen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 把風量加倍必定使有效供氧加倍。~Doubling airflow necessarily doubles useful oxygen transfer.
units.practice: 先點選「曝氣階段供氧」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the aerated-phase oxygen measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 氨轉化與週期終點：硝化的氧需求收支~Ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint: Oxygen balance for nitrification
units.mechanism: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「氨轉化與週期終點」觀察此因果關係。~Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.
units.verify: 用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「氨轉化與週期終點」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 有足夠氧就能保證任意溫度下完全硝化。~Enough oxygen guarantees complete nitrification at any temperature.
units.practice: 先點選「氨轉化與週期終點」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 缺氧階段電子供體：反硝化的電子供體需求~Anoxic-phase donor: Electron-donor demand for denitrification
units.mechanism: 硝酸鹽還原需要電子供體；理論COD當量僅是起點，可利用碳、細胞產率與溶氧競爭會改變需求。本單元在「缺氧階段電子供體」觀察此因果關係。~Nitrate reduction needs an electron donor; theoretical COD equivalence is only a starting point because available carbon, growth and oxygen competition alter demand. Examine this relationship at anoxic-phase donor.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待還原硝酸氮20 kg N/d、理論COD當量2.86 kg/kg N。公式 CODmin=2.86N；代入 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d。適用邊界：理論電子當量示範，不能當現場加藥劑量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: nitrate nitrogen20 kg N/d and theoretical COD equivalence2.86 kg/kg N. Formula CODmin=2.86N; substitution 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d. Boundary: Theoretical electron-equivalent illustration; not a field chemical dose.
units.verify: 同時看硝酸鹽、可利用COD與溶氧，檢查回流帶氧。在離線場景為「缺氧階段電子供體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Observe nitrate, available COD and DO together and inspect oxygen introduced by recirculation. Build an offline evidence table for anoxic-phase donor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 回流氧先消耗基質，會讓只按硝酸鹽估碳量的模型偏低。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Returned oxygen consumes substrate and makes a nitrate-only carbon estimate too low. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總COD全都可以立即供反硝化使用。~All total COD is immediately available for denitrification.
units.practice: 先點選「缺氧階段電子供體」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把硝酸氮改成25 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 71.5 kg COD/d。與基準 57.2 kg COD/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the anoxic-phase donor measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only nitrate nitrogen to25 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 71.5 kg COD/d. Compare with baseline 57.2 kg COD/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 沉澱後排水介面：排水器下降速度~Post-settling decant interface: Decanter lowering rate
units.mechanism: 排水降低液面；排水速率與水面面積決定下降速度，須與污泥層間距一起觀察。本單元在「沉澱後排水介面」觀察此因果關係。~Decanting lowers the surface; flow and surface area set its lowering rate, which must be observed with clearance above the sludge blanket. Examine this relationship at post-settling decant interface.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：排水Q=120 m³/h、表面積A=200 m²。公式 vlevel=Q/A；代入 120/200 = 0.6 m/h。適用邊界：均勻水面與定截面近似，非排水器型號允許值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: decantQ=120 m³/h and surface areaA=200 m². Formula vlevel=Q/A; substitution 120/200 = 0.6 m/h. Boundary: Uniform surface and constant-section approximation, not a decanter product limit.
units.verify: 重播液位與泥層高度，檢查排水末段濁度。在離線場景為「沉澱後排水介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Replay liquid and blanket levels and inspect late-decant turbidity. Build an offline evidence table for post-settling decant interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 泥層上浮或液位感測錯誤可使排水器吸入污泥。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Rising sludge or level-sensor error can make a decanter entrain solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要排水量正確就可以忽略泥層位置。~Correct decant volume makes sludge-blanket position irrelevant.
units.practice: 先點選「沉澱後排水介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把排水Q改成80 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.4 m/h。與基準 0.6 m/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the post-settling decant interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only decantQ to80 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.4 m/h. Compare with baseline 0.6 m/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 曝氣時間與日耗電：間歇曝氣與有效運轉~Aeration time/daily energy: Intermittent aeration and duty
units.mechanism: 每週期曝氣時間決定每日運轉時數；同平均能耗可能對應不同峰值供氧能力。本單元在「曝氣時間與日耗電」觀察此因果關係。~Aeration time per cycle sets daily operating hours; equal average energy can conceal different peak transfer capacity. Examine this relationship at aeration time/daily energy.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：曝氣器功率20 kW、每天曝氣12 h。公式 E=P ton；代入 20*12 = 240 kWh/d。適用邊界：固定輸入功率示範，不等於氧需求或曝氣策略最佳化。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: aerator power20 kW and12 aerated hours per day. Formula E=P ton; substitution 20*12 = 240 kWh/d. Boundary: Fixed-input-power example, not oxygen demand or optimized control.
units.verify: 在週期圖分開記錄曝氣、攪拌、沉澱的電表與狀態。在離線場景為「曝氣時間與日耗電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Log power and states separately for aeration, mixing and settling on the cycle timeline. Build an offline evidence table for aeration time/daily energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 沉澱時曝氣誤開會破壞分離，不只多耗電。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Accidental aeration during settling disrupts separation as well as wasting energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 不同曝氣排程只要總電量相同效果就相同。~Different aeration schedules have identical effects at equal total energy.
units.practice: 先點選「曝氣時間與日耗電」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把每天曝氣時數改成15 h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 300 kWh/d。與基準 240 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the aeration time/daily energy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only aerated time to15 h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 300 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 240 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 跨批次排泥與菌齡：污泥齡與固體流失~Cross-cycle wasting/solids age: Sludge age and solids losses
units.mechanism: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「跨批次排泥與菌齡」觀察此因果關係。~SRT equals system solids inventory divided by daily solids losses; effluent carryover counts as well as wasting. Examine this relationship at cross-cycle wasting/solids age.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. Formula SRT=M/(W+E); substitution 6000/(400+100) = 12 d. Boundary: Quasi-steady inventory with consistent boundaries; intraday inventory changes are neglected.
units.verify: 以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「跨批次排泥與菌齡」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for cross-cycle wasting/solids age; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 不排剩餘污泥就代表沒有生物固體損失。~No intentional wasting means no biomass loss.
units.practice: 先點選「跨批次排泥與菌齡」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10 d。與基準 12 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the cross-cycle wasting/solids age measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10 d. Compare with baseline 12 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

modelChecks.description: 單元1基準：每批污染質量輸入~Unit1 baseline: per-batch pollutant input
單元1變量實驗：只把流量改成1500 m³/d~Unit1 changed-input experiment: change only flow to1500 m³/d
單元2基準：兩批之間進水緩衝~Unit2 baseline: interbatch influent buffer
單元2變量實驗：只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s~Unit2 changed-input experiment: increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s
單元3基準：雙槽週期與日能力~Unit3 baseline: two-basin cycles/daily capacity
單元3變量實驗：只把週期改成8 h~Unit3 changed-input experiment: change only cycle time to8 h
單元4基準：反應期有效水量~Unit4 baseline: reaction-period effective volume
單元4變量實驗：只把有效容積改成600 m³~Unit4 changed-input experiment: change only effective volume to600 m³
單元5基準：曝氣階段供氧~Unit5 baseline: aerated-phase oxygen
單元5變量實驗：只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh~Unit5 changed-input experiment: reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh
單元6基準：氨轉化與週期終點~Unit6 baseline: ammonia conversion/cycle endpoint
單元6變量實驗：只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d~Unit6 changed-input experiment: change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d
單元7基準：缺氧階段電子供體~Unit7 baseline: anoxic-phase donor
單元7變量實驗：只把硝酸氮改成25 kg N/d~Unit7 changed-input experiment: change only nitrate nitrogen to25 kg N/d
單元8基準：沉澱後排水介面~Unit8 baseline: post-settling decant interface
單元8變量實驗：只把排水Q改成80 m³/h~Unit8 changed-input experiment: change only decantQ to80 m³/h
單元9基準：曝氣時間與日耗電~Unit9 baseline: aeration time/daily energy
單元9變量實驗：只把每天曝氣時數改成15 h~Unit9 changed-input experiment: change only aerated time to15 h
單元10基準：跨批次排泥與菌齡~Unit10 baseline: cross-cycle wasting/solids age
單元10變量實驗：只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d~Unit10 changed-input experiment: increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d
